props.heading: What to bring to the first meeting

items.a: Citizenship copies and passport photos of every director, the proposed name, the registered address with a rent agreement, and the share split.
Bank statements, sales and purchase bills for the last three months, and your PAN and VAT certificates.
The letter itself, and the returns filed for the years it mentions. Bring it as soon as it arrives, replies are time-bound.
